sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: CONUS PORTION OF LARGE SCALE PATTERN REMAINS DOMINATED BY MEAN RIDGING OVER W COAST STATES...AND LONGWAVE TROUGH INVOF MS RIVER VALLEY. KEY SHORTWAVE FEATURE IS TROUGH INITIALLY FROM OZARKS SSWWD ACROSS ARKLATEX REGION...NRN PORTION OF WHICH CONTAINS MVC ENHANCEMENT FROM LAST NIGHT'S ACTIVITY OVER SRN PLAINS. THIS TROUGH WILL LIFT NEWD THROUGH REMAINDER EVENING/OVERNIGHT HOURS...CROSSING MOST OF TN/KY. RELATED SFC MESOLOW -- ANALYZED AT 23Z INVOF MEM - SHOULD MOVE NEWD OVER WRN/CENTRAL KY...WITH STRONGEST PRESSURE FALLS AND RELATED ISALLOBARIC FORCING TO ITS NE AND E. SFC COLD FRONT -- INITIALLY SEPARATE FROM MESOLOW OVER MEM AREA...WILL CATCH UP TO LOW AS IT MOVES NEWD ACROSS WRN/CENTRAL KY OVERNIGHT. FARTHER UPSTREAM IN CYCLONIC FLOW BELT ALOFT...SUBTLE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER NWRN NM AND SWRN CO...AND SHOULD MOVE SEWD TOWARD NERN NM AND TX PANHANDLE THROUGH REMAINDER PERIOD. WRN SEGMENT OF SFC FRONTAL ZONE HAS MOVED INTO MOUNTAINS OVER MOST OF NM.

sections.title: MID-SOUTH AND TN VALLEY REGIONS
sections.text: SEVERAL BANDS AND CLUSTERS OF STG-SVR TSTMS ARE MOVING NEWD ACROSS THIS REGION WITH POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL DAMAGING GUSTS...AND ANOTHER TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. CONVECTIVE MODE HAS TRENDED TOWARD BOW ECHOES AND MIXED-MODE...MULTICELL/SUPERCELL CLUSTERS. REF SPC WWS 639...640 AND 642...AS WELL AS RELATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS...FOR NEAR-TERM SVR THREAT. OVERNIGHT STABILIZATION OF PRECONVECTIVE WARM SECTOR...AND RESULTANT DECREASE IN MLCAPE...EACH WILL BE GRADUAL BECAUSE OF VERY HIGH SFC THETAE AND RELATED TENDENCY FOR EFFECTIVE LIFTED PARCELS TO REMAIN SFC-BASED. REMAINING SVR THREAT SHOULD BE WITHIN ZONE OF STRONGEST LOW LEVEL SHEAR LIFTING NEWD OVER REGION. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL REMAIN MAXIMIZED WHERE RELATIVELY BACKED LOW LEVEL WINDS UNDERLIE ERN PORTION OF CHANNEL OF ENHANCED MIDLEVEL FLOW -- I.E. 40-50 KT AT 500 MB -- SE OF OZARKS MVC. LEADING EDGES OF COLD POOLS ASSOCIATED WITH BOWS MAY REMAIN ALIGNED NEARLY NORMAL TO MEAN WIND...AND WILL ENCOUNTER LOW LEVEL AIR MASS THAT SHOULD REMAN FAVORABLY BUOYANT THROUGH MUCH OF THIS EVENING.

sections.title: SRN ROCKIES...SRN HIGH PLAINS...PECOS VALLEY
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS THAT FORMED ON HIGHER TERRAIN OF CENTRAL NM WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE SSEWD TO SEWD ACROSS ADJACENT PECOS VALLEY AND HIGH PLAINS REGIONS THIS EVENING...WITH THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING GUSTS. REF WW 641 AND ITS MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR SPECIFIC NEAR-TERM INFORMATION. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ALREADY INDICATE EARLY STAGES OF UPSCALE ORGANIZATION INTO MCS...WHICH WOULD PROCEED SEWD AS FAR AS PORTIONS SRN PECOS VALLEY AND PERMIAN BASIN REGIONS WITH SVR POTENTIAL BEFORE INFLOW-LAYER INSTABILITY BECOMES TOO WEAK. ..EDWARDS.. 07/31/2009
